reviews.text: We were referred to blue pearl for our cat who presented with fluid issue that our original vet could not diagnose. We could not be happier to have worked with blue pearl and dr. Shemil. The entire team was so helpful and professional, and Dr. Shemil especially. She took her time to review his entire medical records, and explained her findings so clearly and patiently, answering all our questions and concerns with clarity and care. She made a stressful process feel so much less stressful and heavy, followed up quickly, clearly and confidently and supported us throughout the whole process. Thank you for caring for our cat so well and for helping us through this difficult time.

I have, sadly, taken my pet many times to  BluePearl and over the past 2 weeks had had a bad experience... terrible service, insanely long wait times, crazy expensive prices, I was starting to give up. Today was different, Josh at front desk made sure we were seen by a technician as soon as possible, kept checking in and seeing if I needed anything, and went above and beyond to try to make today's visit a bit more peaceful. It gave me a bit of hope on this place again, can't say it's because of the actual hospital, or just one person's job, but thanks Josh!

The staff here are some of the best. Truely compassionate and caring. In an industry that often can run based of dollar amount, this hospital seems to run because they care about what they are doing and who they are there for. This is my 3rd time visiting and each time has been an emergency. Everytime they have gone above the standard of care you would expect to receive. Thank you so much.

No one comes into BluePearl on the wings of victory. We arrived highly stressed on a Tuesday night, when it seemed like every other animal in NYC had somehow managed to be there too. Despite how incredibly busy it was, the staff handled everything with calm and kindness. We felt seen, heard, and cared for, and they were able to give us a treatment plan to tide our little guy over until we could see his primary vet.

I’m incredibly grateful for the kindness, patience, and expertise shown by everyone at this location. Thank you all for taking care of us during a very stressful night!

Walked out after waiting already over an hour for a Dr.
Have been here in years past with my other dog and was always in great hands. Hopefully this was just an off night but would have appreciated more communication from the staff.

My dog was bitten by another dog, so I brought him in as an emergency patient. Unfortunately, even though it was an emergency visit, it took quite a while for him to be seen.

The area I specifically pointed out, where his skin had been punctured, was checked. However, after we got home, I found additional bite marks and puncture wounds that had been missed during the exam.

I appreciate the care he received, but given the situation, I wish the examination had been a little more thorough, especially since dog bites can involve multiple puncture wounds that aren’t immediately obvious.
Service was thorough and attentive. Pricing corresponds to location so it is on the expensive side.
Thank you for choosing us to care for your pet! It’s a privilege to be part of their journey, and we’re so grateful for your trust and positive review.
It’s an honor to care for your pet! Our team is dedicated to providing the best possible care, and knowing we’ve earned your trust means everything. We truly appreciate your support!

The moment I get to the hospital, my pup is ushered to a room to be examined. The staff and doctors are knowledgeable and genuinely care about the pet. I had another dog before I got Spirit and have been going to them for years with my emergency needs.

THIS PLACE IS A TOTAL RIP OFF AVOID IT LIKE THE PLAGUE...IT CHARGES MUCH MORE THAN ALTERNATIVE VET HOSPITALS!! I started going to BluePearl when I needed emergency care for my dogs and was shocked by the pricing and after doing thorough investigation determined that the pricing at Blue Pearl is much higher than what alternative 24 hour vet hospitals charged.  Then i learned that Blue Pearl is owned by Mars whatevrer which is a corporation owning vet hospitals across multiple states where in my personal view the focus is on maximizing profit rather than vet care.  There are much better alternatives like VEG ER which offers 24 hour emergency care at corner of 24th and 6th Avenue with better care at much lower pricing

First off, I want to preface this review by saying that I’m not even from New York City, but I felt compelled to write this on behalf of someone dear to me and her beloved Labrador Retriever, who sadly passed away. When someone from OUT OF STATE feels the need to speak up, I think that says a lot about how disappointing the experience was.

The nightmare began when her Labrador, who normally had an excellent appetite, suddenly started eating less. His condition continued to worsen, and he eventually developed breathing issues, so she rushed him to BluePearl Hospital for treatment.

Upon arrival, her dog was reportedly prescribed antibiotics, but eventually, she was advised to pursue additional testing, including an ultrasound. However, according to her experience, it was not clearly communicated early on that BluePearl did NOT have ultrasound equipment available and that she would need to go elsewhere. This was only made clear once her dog’s condition had become imminent. By this point, she had already spent thousands of dollars on treatments that still did not provide clear answers about what was wrong with her dog.

She also had concerns about the timing of certain treatments, including antibiotics. Throughout the process, she was told her dog’s condition was ultimately identified as gastroenteritis, but she was left feeling that more could have been done to determine the true cause. Being repeatedly presented with euthanasia as an option while she was still hoping for answers felt like a slap in the face and felt as though the hospital was giving up rather than fighting for her dog.

The final moments were especially heartbreaking. She was devastated that her dog was placed on a towel on the floor, and she was frustrated that the discharge process took hours as she planned to transport her dog to another hospital for better care.

The only reason I’m not giving this hospital a measly one star is because the receptionists were kind enough to help carry her dog to her car during a terrible blizzard. Their compassion was appreciated.

While it’s understandable that veterinary care is an incredibly stressful field, that does not excuse poor communication or a lack of empathy. I hope this review encourages better communication and care for future pet owners. Losing a beloved pet is already devastating, and not having answers about what happened makes the grief even harder.
Your trust means so much to us! Caring for your pet brings us so much joy, and we’re truly grateful to be a part of their health and happiness. Thank you for your support!
The staff was incredible. The nurse and the doctor were attentive and caring and explained everything perfectly

My pup somehow got a hold of combat bait trap and ate it i came straight to blue pearl emergency.As soon as I got there , they took my dog right away to the emergency room , took care of her staff was kind of courteous, this is my first time going there . If I have any future emergencies with my dog I will come back here  thank you so much.

This place is amazing, you as a pet parent are treated with respect, empathy.
Everyone that works here is amazing the front desk, the ER staff, all nurses, techs, doctors everyone, when I say everyone I mean everyone, my experience was one of a kind, my pet Peaches was hit by a car and in a moment where I didn’t know what to do, where to go, what was going to happen Blue Pearl popped in to my head as I was driving looking for a place to take care of my pet I called and they said come in we are here for you and Peaches and the rest is history.
They may be on the pricier side of vet care, but trust me it’s worth every penny, once I saw how they cared I wasn’t hesitant to trust my Peaches care to them, I was able to be with her, they respected the fact that I was unable to leave her there by herself, but when I realized how amazing they all are I came home and rested to go pick her up the following day after her pelvis repair surgery.
I recommend a million times!!!!!
Compasionate care without breaking the bank in an emergency. Thank you!

I took my cat with a squinting eye to Blue Pearl at 2am on a Saturday. I had a plane to catch in a few hours. Everyone was perfect from the front desk who was very caring to the vet technician to the vet. They took care of my baby and prescribed some medication making sure I understood well how to apply it so I could explain to the cat sitter. If it was not for the service at Blue Pearl, I would have cancelled my flight, but it was not necessary because of their exceptional work. Thank you, Blue Pearl. You were perfect!

I had a great experience at BluePearl Pet Hospital. The staff was kind, professional, and took wonderful care of my BeBo. 🐶❤️ They made me feel comfortable knowing he was in good hands. I truly appreciate the care and attention they gave him. Thank you to the entire team!
Truly among the best.  Not cheap, but we all do what we have to do for our pets! Our Great Dane Magnus received emergency excellent care from a loving staff.  5 Stars!!
Thorough and rapid care after my dog ate a chocolate chip cookie.
Thank you for the 5 stars review.

We have been seeing the neurology team at Blue Pearl for years.  They are wonderful.  The ER team is also top notch and they saved our dog’s life when there was little hope.  Couldn’t speak more highly of Blue Pearl.

BluePearl Midtown has saved the lives of two of our cats in the past two years through surgery, and has provided fast and easy x-rays on another visit. They are always so kind and professional, and get us in and out as quickly as possible under the circumstances. The billing is sometimes insane and there’s a base charge of ~$275 for the visits to start, but that just feels par for the course with emergency services in general. Overall the care has been excellent.

Took my cat here last night for suspected urinary blockage. Everyone was very welcoming and answered all my questions. The wait times are pretty long I was there for a total of almost 3-4 hours. All the care for my cat was done in the back, so I couldn't see how they were treating her, however when we got home she was very happy and didn't show any signs of fear she normally does after the vet so I believe they were very kind and good to her. The services are rather pricy, but they did a fair amount of tests and broad spectrum of medications to ensure my cat has the best treatment she can so it's not too bad. I spent about $800 for what turned out to likely be a UTI, but that covered the fast ultrasound, bloodwork, IV fluids, and the 4 medications they sent me home with. Overall good service I would go again.
They got her in immediately. There was no weight. The facilities are clean. The staff is so nice and my dog was in the ICU for four days and they let me come visit and spend time with her every day.

EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE!!!! Wow wow wow. Thank you Iris the tech who managed our intake and My dog’s treatment and the communication throughout. Unfortunately, I cant remember my Vet’s name but she was also incredible! Highly intelligent, respectful of me as the parent and got things done.

My dog has so many issues so we’ve been in and out of the vet/ER for 3 years. This was my first excellent experience in my entire time in NYC. Moved him over from AMC to this hospital because of the exceptional staff and service to the animals. Cant recommend them enough. Thank you guys!

I visited Blue Pearl Midtown for their Oncology department. I really like Dr. Rocha - I think he took his time to offer a thorough consultation and plan of action; what I didn't like is they don't do your pet's exam in the room with you, it's elsewhere and I didn't realize I was going to have to leave my cat all day for diagnostics that she already had, but were outdated. I understood why we needed to redo them, but it just sort of threw us for a loop, but overall we were happy with the visit. I do wish, however, that the process for communicating after was easier, whether it be a direct email or chat with the Oncology dept. Any time I have a Q, I have to go through the front desk, they relay it and then I get a call back at their earliest convenience. They have always called back and been on top of all the Qs, but just wish there was a bit of a more direct line of communication. All in all, I would recommend though.

I brought my dog in at 3am after she had a seizure. They were kind and very thorough. They explained my options very clearly. The hospital was clean and all the staff was friendly. I highly recommend this for emergencies.

As far as veterinarian services Blue Pearl is certainly one of the best. They have some of the top Veterinarians, their staff and teams not only to handle the animals, but handle us humans the owners make us feel welcomed, heard and seen. They are always service with a smile and making you and your pet Get the best quality care. As much as Sidney Would like to never go to see a vet she knows that they care and eventually gives in.
